title: Lieb-Thirring Conjecture on the Sharp Constant for Riesz Means of Order One in Three Dimensions
exact_target: Is the semiclassical value $1/(15\pi^2)$ the exact best constant controlling total negative Schr\"odinger energy by the integral of the potential's negative part to power $5/2$?

sources.citation: Rupert L. Frank, The Lieb-Thirring inequalities: Recent results and open problems, arXiv:2007.09326 (2020).
